name: 20853 · Rockville, MD
findings: ZIP 20853 (Rockville) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20853 (Rockville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
